[[File:Ekloska_Hills.jpg|250px|thumb|Ekloska Hills on a map of Chekkoo Province]]
The '''Ekloska Hills''' were a small range of hills spanning the eastern border of [[Chekkoo Province]] on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. The headwaters of the [[Teonsqua River]] were located in the hills.
